accounts.name: launch
docs: `Account<>` on purpose: the owner check IS the "before delegate_launch"
guard. Once delegated the launch is DLP-owned and this instruction is
permanently unreachable (no undelegate path while BONDING), so the
create tx must bundle enable_pump ahead of delegate_launch.

accounts.name: launch
docs: lives in the ER, so no Account<> owner check can pass here. Seeds
pin the address; we hand-deserialize the L1 snapshot (data is
preserved under delegation) just to gate on state.

accounts.name: gate
docs: (never armed), which require_gate treats as an open door.

accounts.name: gate_signer
docs: gate.key while armed; any unsigned pubkey while the door is open.

accounts.name: platform
docs: The crank is deliberately NOT permissionless: `amount` is chosen by
the caller, so a stranger could hand a holder one token and burn the
single claim the session gets. Read only for the admin check.

accounts.name: mint
docs: the Mooner mint — authority revoked at the end, supply stays 0

docs: the WALLET — the only party allowed to swap trade keys

instructions.name: set_gate
docs: Arm (or disarm, with Pubkey::default()) the entry gate: while armed,
opening or topping up a trade session requires this key's co-signature.

accounts.name: launch
docs: Typed `Account<>` on purpose: the owner check means the launch must be
home (`commit_launch` undelegated it) before the admin can pin.

instructions.name: set_token_metadata
docs: Attach the Metaplex face (name/symbol from the launch account, URI to
the pinned JSON). Admin-only; works until lock_mint revokes authority.
